verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Loops' API/CLI/MCP/email-sending features but contains no documentation of bounce, complaint, or blocklist reporting per send, nor any actionable deliverability-degradation guidance; 'Guardian checks' (loops-docs-19) is mentioned without detail on what it covers. Community discussion even raises unresolved concerns about deliverability practices (loops-comm-5) rather than confirming a monitoring feature.
